title: Rig Relay Repository Context Release v1
description: Canonical evidence artifact produced after quarantine, intake, structural indexing, dependency classification, risk assessment, and safe validation probing. Declares a repository safe and useful for agent workspace allocation.

release_id.description: Unique identifier for this context release.

repository_root.description: Absolute path to the repository root.

lifecycle_state.description: Current lifecycle state of the repository context pipeline.

quarantine.description: Quarantine metadata; null for local repositories.

instruction_map_digest.description: Instruction map digest; set after INSTRUCTIONS_DISCOVERED.

structural_index_digest.description: Structural index digest; set after STRUCTURE_INDEXED.

dependency_risk_summary.description: Dependency risk summary; set after DEPENDENCIES_CLASSIFIED.

execution_risk_summary.description: Execution risk summary; set after EXECUTION_RISKS_REVIEWED.

safe_validation_results.description: Results of admitted safe validation commands.

workspace_eligibility.description: Workspace eligibility assessment; set after workspace eligibility check.

restrictions.description: Human-readable runtime restrictions derived from risk assessment.

blockers.description: Conditions or defects preventing lifecycle advancement.

degraded.description: True when one or more lifecycle stages failed or produced degraded results.

context_confidence.description: Estimated confidence in the completeness and correctness of this context release (0.0 to 1.0).

released_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this context release was emitted.

content_digest.description: SHA256 hex digest of the canonical release JSON (excluding this field).

provenance.description: Evidence references mapping stage names to evidence digests.

quarantine_path.description: Absolute path where the repository was cloned into quarantine.

cloned_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the clone completed.

source_url.description: Remote URL the repository was cloned from.

source_head_sha.description: Full SHA of the commit at clone time.

is_read_only.description: True when the quarantine path is read-only.

instruction_file_count.description: Total count of instruction files discovered.

nested_instruction_count.description: Count of nested instruction files within scope chains.

scope_conflicts.description: Number of instruction scope conflicts detected.

top_level_kinds.description: Count of each InstructionKind among top-level instruction files.

map_sha256.description: SHA256 hex digest of the canonical instruction map.

exported_symbol_count.description: Total number of exported symbols across all modules.

parser_errors.description: Total count of module files that failed to parse.

index_digest.description: Matches StructuralIndex.index_digest for the index this digest represents.

total_dependencies.description: Total dependency count across all dependency sets.

risk_count.description: Count of dependencies classified with risk above NONE.

total_scripts_assessed.description: Total number of scripts and manifests assessed.

blocked_count.description: Number of assessments that are blocked from execution.

dangerous_count.description: Number of assessments with DANGEROUS or REJECTED risk level.

safe_count.description: Number of assessments with SAFE risk level and no detections.

command.description: The admitted validation command that was executed.

exit_code.description: Exit code of the executed command.

output_digest.description: SHA256 hex digest of combined stdout and stderr.

passed.description: True when the command exited successfully with expected output.

eligible.description: True when the repository meets all workspace eligibility criteria.

recommended_workspace_kind.description: Recommended workspace kind: read_only, managed_write, etc.

path_policy.description: Per-path policy mapping: path -> read, write, or forbidden.
